turns.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi! I’d like to book a flight for my friend, Ivan Smith. I want his reservation to be exactly the same as my current one. Also, I’d like to use my certificate for payment if possible, but I want to know how much balance will be left after the booking. If there’s going to be more than $100 left unused, I’d prefer to use my gift card and credit card instead. No baggage or insurance needed. Can you help me with this?
I can help you with this! To proceed, I’ll need your user ID to look up your current reservation and payment methods. Could you please provide your user ID?
Sure, my user ID is ivan_muller_7015.

Here’s what I’ll do to help you book a reservation for your friend Ivan Smith, matching your current reservation:

- Same flights: DTW → PHX (HAT097) and PHX → SEA (HAT251) on 2024-05-17, economy class, one-way.
- No baggage or insurance.
- Payment: I’ll check the total price and see if your certificate will have more than $100 left after booking. If so, I’ll use your gift card and credit card instead.

To proceed, can you confirm:
- Only Ivan Smith (born 1986-03-14) will be on this reservation?
- Is the above information correct and do you want to continue?
Yes, that’s correct—just Ivan Smith on this reservation. All the details you listed are right. Please go ahead!

Here’s the plan for booking Ivan Smith’s reservation:

- Flights: DTW → PHX (HAT097, economy, $175) and PHX → SEA (HAT251, economy, $200) on 2024-05-17.
- Total price: $375.
- If you use your certificate ($500 balance), you’ll have $125 left after booking, which is more than $100.
- Based on your preference, I will use your gift card ($128 balance) and credit card for payment instead.

Please confirm that you’d like to proceed with this payment method (gift card + credit card), and I’ll complete the booking for Ivan Smith.
Yes, please proceed with the gift card and credit card for payment. Thank you!

Ivan Smith’s reservation has been successfully booked with the following details:

- Flights: DTW → PHX (HAT097, economy) and PHX → SEA (HAT251, economy) on 2024-05-17
- Passenger: Ivan Smith (1986-03-14)
- No baggage or insurance
- Payment: $128 from your gift card and $247 from your credit card

If you need the reservation ID or any further assistance, just let me know!
That’s perfect, thank you! I don’t need anything else right now. Have a great day! ###STOP###
